title: Channel media queue item response (PRF-02 slice 7, catalogue module #20)
description: The creator-facing projection of one queued media item, returned by enqueue, update and status-change. CREATOR-ONLY (owner decision, 2026-09-17; register row MED-20): there is no submitter identity field anywhere on this schema, because there is no submitter other than the creator -- every row is written through the role-gated enqueue route alone. status carries PLAYBACK values only (queued/played/skipped), never a moderation decision such as approved/rejected/pending_review. Available identically at every tier (12.6): storing, viewing, editing and changing the status of a durable creator record is never tier-gated.

status.description: PLAYBACK lifecycle only. Never approved/rejected/pending_review or any moderation-shaped value.

enabled.description: A creator-only pause switch. Pulling an item from the live rotation is never a delete (12.6): the durable row stays exactly as it is.
